in_hebrew.name: Euh
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Euh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek 'eu' (good) and 'eus' (god). This name signifies the belief in the existence of a supreme deity.

in_greek.name: Euh
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God exists
in_greek.long_meaning: Euh είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek 'eu' (good) and 'eus' (god). This name signifies the belief in the existence of a supreme deity.

in_latin.name: Euh
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God exists
in_latin.long_meaning: Euh est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek 'eu' (good) and 'eus' (god). This name signifies the belief in the existence of a supreme deity.
